Arantxa Rus ( Dutch pronunciation: [aːˈrɑɲtɕaː ˈrʏs] ; born 13 December 1990) is a Dutch professional tennis player.
She won one WTA Tour singles title at the 2023 Hamburg Open and four in doubles. Her biggest singles successes to date include a second-round upset over world No. 2, Kim Clijsters , at the 2011 French Open , reaching the fourth round at the 2012 French Open , and defeating world No. 5, Samantha Stosur , in the 2012 Wimbledon Championships to reach the third round. [ 1 ] Career [ edit ] 2005–07 [ edit ] At age 14, Rus played her first ITF Women's Circuit tournament at Alkmaar where she lost in the second round to Julie Coin . In 2006, she played two more ITF events at Heerhugowaard and Vlaardingen, reaching the semifinals at the latter.
